description: Neutral seed for task-type centroids — untrained prior: all six task-type centroids are the zero vector, so every query scores 0.0 cosine against every centroid and the classifier abstains with low_confidence=True. Calibration is rebuilt locally via task_classifier.py rebuild-centroids, which replaces the zero vector per task-type with the mean of the locked seed-query embeddings for that task.
